theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → ∀ (Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P) (E : Set (Eucl P)), MeasurableSet E → (∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' E) = 0) → μ E = 0
